emotional_tone: Disciplined, elite, clinical yet intense (command center).

quick_action_button.positive: bg-emerald-500 text-black hover:bg-emerald-400 border-none h-24 text-xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2
quick_action_button.negative: bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-500 border-none h-24 text-xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2

bottom_nav.wrapper: fixed bottom-0 w-full h-16 backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/80 border-t border-white/10 flex justify-around items-center z-50 px-2 pb-safe

icons.usage: Use icons heavily in the Quick Action buttons and Bottom Nav to ensure fast recognition.

images.description: Dark athletic gym background with weights, suitable for an optional welcome screen or empty state overlay.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-secondary (A3A3A3) passes WCAG AA on surface (171717).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST use data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid="log-action-btn-study", data-testid="nav-dashboard").

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first PWA layout. The app should live entirely in a Max Width container (e.g. max-w-md mx-auto) or span full width on mobile.
Use Shadcn UI primarily for complex interactive components (Dialog, Tabs, Toast/Sonner), but use raw Tailwind for the main bento dashboard layout to ensure tight spacing and custom athletic styling.
Do NOT use Recharts or any charting library. Use pure HTML/Tailwind div-based progress bars for the Weekly Review charts.
Store all data in localStorage. Pre-populate default Pat Riley CBE actions (e.g., Study, Exercise, Build = Positive; Scroll, Game, Junk Food = Negative) so the user has immediate value.
Ensure the design feels like Whoop/Strava: highly tactical, minimal soft shadows, pure dark mode (#0A0A0A background), high-contrast data.
Implement 'Undo' function in the toast notification via Sonner.
